stem.text: Three tests were performed on an unknown organic compound.
What is the organic compound tested?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: iodine atom at the left end of a zigzag chain, with a C=O group at the right end

B.alt: Skeletal formula: two C=O groups drawn downward from two carbons, each carbonyl carbon with a methyl-type end group, joined through a central carbon

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a zigzag chain ending in a C=O group at the right end

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a zigzag chain with a C=O group drawn downward from a central carbon, and an iodine atom at the right end
